scope: Local negative auxiliary LOGIT-gradient direction at sampled wrongly-classified foreground voxels touched by original bands. Counts include repeated observations; this is not the Adam/network update or held-out performance.
finding: 98.95% to99.83% of observed touched wrong-foreground voxels have a worsened true-versus-best-wrong logit margin under the isolated bands direction. Occurs in both helped and harmed run, so does not alone explain their validation difference.
mechanism: Original bands pool classes1/2/3 against background; they supervise hippocampus union, not subfield identity. More probable foreground logits receive greater inward foreground encouragement.
implication: Preserve original definition as user requested. Test finite timing and consider original per-class SDF/depth composition if windows fail.
